WIX Platform Integration
This proposal outlines the development of a professional web-based landing page built on WIX platform, featuring online booking capabilities and HitPay payment gateway for seamless customer transactions.
Feature Overview
1. Web Landing Page
A modern, responsive landing page built on WIX platform that showcases your services and products with professional design and user-friendly interface.
  • Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • SEO-optimized structure for better search visibility
  • Custom branding and theme matching your corporate identity
  • Easy content management through WIX CMS
  • Multi-language support capabilities
  • Fast loading times and optimized performance
WIX WIX Studio WIX Velo WIX Bookings
2. Online Booking System
A comprehensive booking engine powered by WIX Bookings, allowing customers to schedule appointments, reserve services, or book products directly from the landing page.
  • Real-time availability calendar
  • Automated booking confirmation emails
  • Booking management dashboard in WIX
  • Customizable booking forms with validation
  • Calendar sync with Google/Outlook
  • Booking status tracking (Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled)
  • Automated reminders and notifications
WIX Bookings WIX Automations Calendar Integration
3. HitPay Payment Gateway Integration
Secure payment processing through HitPay integrated with WIX, supporting multiple payment methods including credit cards, GrabPay, PayNow, and more.
  • Secure payment processing with PCI DSS compliance
  • Support for multiple payment methods (Credit/Debit Cards, GrabPay, PayNow, Fomo)
  • Automated payment status updates in WIX
  • Payment receipt generation and email delivery
  • Recurring payment support for subscription-based services
  • Refund and cancellation handling
  • Payment reconciliation reports in WIX dashboard
HitPay API WIX Payments WIX Velo

Component Description Technology

Booking System Online appointment and service booking WIX Bookings

WIX Platform Benefits
Why WIX?
  • User-Friendly CMS: Easy-to-use content management system for non-technical users
  • Reliable Hosting: 99.9% uptime with global CDN for fast loading worldwide
  • Security: Built-in SSL certificate, DDoS protection, and regular security updates
  • Scalability: Easily scale as your business grows without technical complexity
  • Mobile Optimization: Automatic mobile-responsive design for all devices
  • 24/7 Support: Access to WIX support team and extensive documentation
Data Management
  • Customer Database: Built-in CRM for managing customer information and interactions
  • Booking Management: Centralized dashboard for managing all bookings and appointments
  • Payment Tracking: Complete payment history and reconciliation in WIX dashboard
  • Analytics: Built-in analytics for tracking visitor behavior and conversions
  • Email Marketing: Integrated email marketing tools for customer engagement

Phase 3: Integration HitPay payment integration, testing, security validation 5 days

PROPOSAL DOCUMENT

Project Title: Odoo Rebuild System - Data Migration

From Version: Odoo 16

To Version: Odoo 19

Focus Area: Data Migration Only

Proposal ID: doc.name

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

This proposal outlines the comprehensive data migration strategy for upgrading an existing Odoo 16 system to Odoo 19. The project focuses exclusively on data migration while preserving business continuity, data integrity, and system functionality. This migration will leverage Odoo's native migration tools and custom scripts to ensure seamless transition of all business-critical data.

2. PROJECT SCOPE

2.1 In-Scope Activities

  • Complete database migration from Odoo 16 to Odoo 19
  • Custom module data migration
  • Configuration data transfer
  • Historical data preservation
  • File and attachment migration
  • User and permission data migration
  • Multi-company data migration (if applicable)

2.2 Out-of-Scope Activities

  • Custom code development
  • Theme customization migration
  • Third-party integration setup
  • Hardware infrastructure upgrades
  • User training (post-migration)
  • Performance optimization beyond migration requirements
  • New feature implementation

3. TECHNICAL APPROACH

3.1 Migration Methodology

  1. Pre-Migration Analysis
    • Database structure assessment
    • Custom module inventory
    • Data volume analysis
    • Dependency mapping
  2. Migration Execution
    • Odoo native migration path utilization
    • Custom data transformation scripts
    • Incremental data validation
    • Rollback strategy implementation
  3. Post-Migration Validation
    • Data integrity verification
    • Functional testing
    • Performance benchmarking
    • User acceptance testing

3.2 Data Categories to Migrate

  • Master Data: Customers, suppliers, products, employees
  • Transactional Data: Sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, journal entries
  • Configuration Data: Chart of accounts, fiscal years, taxes, payment terms
  • Custom Data: Custom fields, custom models, workflow configurations
  • Attachment Data: Documents, images, files linked to records
  • User Data: User accounts, permissions, access rights

5. DELIVERABLES

5.1 Pre-Migration Deliverables

  • Detailed data mapping document
  • Migration risk assessment report
  • Backup and rollback procedures
  • Test plan and validation criteria

5.2 Migration Deliverables

  • Migrated Odoo 19 database
  • Migration execution logs
  • Data transformation scripts
  • Post-migration validation report

5.3 Post-Migration Deliverables

  • Final validation report
  • Data reconciliation summary
  • Migration completion certificate
  • Lessons learned documentation

6. RISK MITIGATION

6.1 Identified Risks

  • Data corruption during migration
  • Extended downtime
  • Custom data incompatibility
  • Performance degradation post-migration
  • Data loss scenarios

6.2 Mitigation Strategies

  • Multiple Backup Strategy: Full database backups before each migration phase
  • Staged Migration: Incremental migration with validation at each stage
  • Rollback Plan: Detailed rollback procedures for each migration phase
  • Test Environment: Full replication in test environment before production
  • Data Validation: Automated and manual validation checks at each step

7. RESOURCE REQUIREMENTS

7.1 Technical Team

  • Technical Lead: Jose Mangiliman Jr
  • Functional Consultant: Jose Mangiliman Jr

7.2 Customer Team

  • Project Manager: To be assigned by client
  • Project Champion: To be assigned by client

7.3 Infrastructure Requirements

  • Development environment (Odoo 19)
  • Test environment (replica of production)
  • Storage for backups (3x current database size)
  • Migration tools and utilities

9. ASSUMPTIONS & DEPENDENCIES

9.1 Assumptions

  • Current Odoo 16 system is stable and fully functional

10.2 Business Success Metrics
